instruction: Hide slide 4 (the QUIZ - FORESTS slide) in the Forests presentation so it won't show during the slideshow.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent attempted to use Summary Slide feature in LibreOffice Impress. It navigated to the Slide menu and found the Summary Slide option, but struggled with selecting all slides first. It repeatedly tried Ctrl+A, scrolled through slide panel, and accidentally duplicated slides, ending with 14-15 slides instead of a proper summary. Ran out of 50 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate LibreOffice Impress menus (Slide, Edit, View), click slides in slide panel, scroll through slides, use keyboard shortcuts, access Slide menu options including Hide Slide
metadata.failure_analysis: Model failed to properly execute the multi-step Summary Slide workflow. It could not reliably select all slides simultaneously and kept accidentally creating extra slides.
metadata.task_rationale: Simplified to hiding a single slide — the model saw 'Hide Slide' in the Slide menu during its trajectory. This tests targeted slide management via a simple right-click or menu action without multi-selection.
metadata.explanation: Task requires hiding slide 4 (0-based index 3). Getter reads the saved PPTX and checks the 'show' attribute on the <p:sld> root element of the individual slide via python-pptx slide._element.get('show'). show='0' means hidden. Partial credit: 0.4 for slide count unchanged (12), 0.1 for title match confirming correct slide, 0.5 for slide being hidden. [Fixed: replaced incorrect sldId-based hidden check with slide._element.get('show'); added title verification in metric]

scoring_breakdown.slide_count: 0.4 - Total slides remains 12 (hiding does not remove slides)
scoring_breakdown.hidden_status: 0.5 - Slide 4 has show='0' attribute on <p:sld> element

fix_history: Fix 1: Replaced incorrect sldId-based hidden check in getter with slide._element.get('show') to read the 'show' attribute from the correct <p:sld> element of the individual slide XML
Fix 2: Added title verification (0.1 credit) in metric to confirm the correct slide (QUIZ - FORESTS) is being evaluated, rebalanced scoring from 0.4/0.6 to 0.4/0.1/0.5

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the 'show' attribute from the <p:sld> element via slide._element.get('show'), which is the proper OOXML method for detecting hidden slides (show='0' means hidden). Previous sldId-based bug has been fixed.
Metric correctly handles the expected parameter directly (no erroneous expected.get('rules') pattern), properly accessing expected_hidden, expected_title, and expected_slide_count.

Full coverage: evaluator verifies (1) slide count unchanged at 12 (hiding doesn't remove slides), (2) correct slide identified via title match 'QUIZ - FORESTS', and (3) slide is actually hidden. All three aspects of the instruction are checked.
Postconfig properly activates the window and saves the file (Ctrl+S) before evaluation, ensuring the getter reads fresh state.

Minor: title extraction uses first non-empty text from any shape rather than specifically the title placeholder, but the case-insensitive substring check ('in' operator) makes this robust enough for 'QUIZ - FORESTS'.
